description: Abstract class for a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter in the Eclipse Hono project, providing request handling, tracing, metrics, and lifecycle management for HTTP communication with devices.

classes.name: AbstractVertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class providing core functionality for a Vert.x-based HTTP protocol adapter in Eclipse Hono, including lifecycle, request handling, tracing, metrics, and configuration.

methods.name: setMetrics
methods.description: Sets the metrics object for this adapter.

methods.name: getMetrics
methods.description: Retrieves the metrics object.

methods.name: getPortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns default port 8443 for secure connections.

methods.name: getInsecurePortDefaultValue
methods.description: Returns default port 8080 for insecure connections.

methods.name: getActualPort
methods.description: Returns the actual port the secure server is listening on.

methods.name: getActualInsecurePort
methods.description: Returns the actual port the insecure server is listening on.

methods.name: setHttpServer
methods.description: Assigns a pre-configured secure HttpServer instance.

methods.name: setInsecureHttpServer
methods.description: Assigns a pre-configured insecure HttpServer instance.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Starts the adapter, creating routers and binding servers.

methods.name: createRouter
methods.description: Creates and configures a Vert.x Router with handlers for metrics, tracing, error handling, and request size limiting.

methods.name: addRoutes
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to add custom routes.

methods.name: getHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Provides default TLS server options with host, port, and TLS certs.

methods.name: getInsecureHttpServerOptions
methods.description: Provides default non-TLS server options with host and port.

methods.name: uploadTelemetryMessage
methods.description: Uploads telemetry data from a device via HTTP.

methods.name: uploadEventMessage
methods.description: Uploads event data from a device via HTTP.

methods.name: doUploadMessage
methods.description: Core method to handle message upload, including validation, tracing, and downstream sending.

methods.name: uploadCommandResponseMessage
methods.description: Uploads a command response back to the application.

methods.name: getQoSLevel
methods.description: Determines QoS level from header and endpoint type.

methods.name: getTimeUntilDisconnectFromRequest
methods.description: Extracts TTD (Time To Disconnect) from request, defaulting to HttpUtils method.

methods.name: setTtdRequestConnectionCloseHandler
methods.description: Sets handler to close connection if device disconnects before response.

methods.name: setResponsePayload
methods.description: Sets HTTP response payload based on command context.

methods.name: setEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Responds with HTTP 202 Accepted for empty command responses.

methods.name: setNonEmptyResponsePayload
methods.description: Responds with command details and HTTP 200 OK.

methods.name: createCommandConsumer
methods.description: Creates a consumer for device commands, supporting TTD and concurrency options.

methods.name: isGatewayMappingEnabled
methods.description: Determines if gateway mapping is enabled based on tenant configuration.

methods.name: isSupportConcurrentGatewayDeviceCommandRequests
methods.description: Checks tenant configuration for support of concurrent gateway device command requests.

methods.name: isCommandValid
methods.description: Validates if a command is valid for sending.

methods.name: addCommandReceptionTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer to send empty response if no command received within TTD.

methods.name: cancelCommandReceptionTimer
methods.description: Cancels the command reception timer.
